# HitPay

HitPay provides payment processing, commerce, invoicing, recurring billing, payout, and business-management APIs for merchants.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hitpay/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Status** (read-only): Check the connected HitPay business's verification, bank-account, and payment-provider readiness.
- **Get Balances** (read-only): Return available, pending, deposit, and reserve balances by currency and wallet provider.
- **Get Location** (read-only): Retrieve one HitPay business location by ID.
- **Get Payment Request** (read-only): Retrieve the current status and details of one HitPay payment request.
- **List Charges** (read-only): Search completed and attempted charges by status, date, amount, payment request, customer, or location.
- **List Customers** (read-only): List customer records stored by the connected HitPay business.
- **List Invoices** (read-only): Find invoices by customer email, status, or merchant reference.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List business locations, optionally filtering by name keywords or an exact location ID.
- **List Orders** (read-only): Search HitPay commerce orders by version, status, date, or keywords.
- **List Payment Requests** (read-only): Search hosted payment requests and inspect their current payment status.
- **List Product Categories** (read-only): Browse or search active and nested HitPay product categories.
- **List Products** (read-only): Search the HitPay product catalog using product, inventory, location, and sales-channel filters.
- **List Recurring Billings** (read-only): Find recurring billing records by customer, reference, plan, or status.
- **List Staff** (read-only): Return staff members visible to the connected HitPay business account.
- **List Subscription Plans** (read-only): List recurring-payment plans configured for the connected HitPay business.
